subject: SIG questionnaire: pen test report staging and redaction clarifications
messages:
From: Alicia Tan <compliance@novahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Nova Health Security Team <security@novahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: SIG baseline: pen test report required for artifact list

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of Nova Health's vendor SIG baseline we need the full pen test report (redacted) uploaded to our GRC portal to satisfy the 'Offensive Security' artifact requirement. The portal lists the following required items:

- Executive summary (redacted as needed)
- Full findings with risk ratings (redacted PII)
- Evidence mapping CSV/worksheet linking CVEs to mitigation tickets

Can you confirm whether the redacted executive summary and a findings spreadsheet are available this week? If redaction will take longer, Nova can accept a redacted exec summary plus a remediation log in lieu of the full findings for initial intake.

Portal upload link: https://grc.novahealth.com/upload/records/NR-9841

Thanks,
Alicia Tan
Senior Compliance Manager
Nova Health

Attachment: SIG-questionnaire-extract.pdf (PDF 120KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Tan <compliance@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG baseline: pen test report required for artifact list

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the clarity and the portal link. Short answers: yes and yes, with caveats. We have an executive summary prepared that we can redact for customer-identifying IP and internal hostnames. The full findings include sensitive triage notes that our redaction team needs to review; that will take a few business days.

Plan proposal:
- Today (12/10): upload redacted executive summary + a one-page remediation status snapshot to the portal
- By 12/17: deliver a findings spreadsheet (redacted) and a CSV mapping to remediation tickets

Vivek / Ops — can you confirm we can surface a remediation-log extract and a redacted exec summary by EOD 12/10 and whether we are comfortable with the proposed 12/17 date for the findings?

Olga
Director, GRC Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: request-log-ack.txt (plain text)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG baseline: pen test report required for artifact list

Thanks — quick status update from SecOps:

- We have an exec summary draft that strips hostnames, IP ranges, and the names of external test targets. We will also remove verbatim PoC content that could be weaponized.
- The findings spreadsheet requires correlating internal ticket IDs; that is ongoing. We can produce a sanitized XLSX by 12/17.
- As an interim artifact for Nova's intake we can export a remediation-log CSV that maps finding IDs to ticket numbers and current status (attached). That should satisfy "evidence mapping" for initial review.

Flag for Legal: Rishi, some customers request unredacted technical appendices for internal security review. We should confirm what level of technical detail we permit sharing under our vendor policy.

Vivek
Head of Security, Redwood Inference

Attachment: remediation-log-20261211.csv (CSV 14KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG baseline: pen test report required for artifact list

We should stick to our redaction baseline for external uploads. Legal review notes:

- Exec summary: okay to share redacted version (no hostnames, no internal IPs, no customer names).
- Findings spreadsheet: share only redacted fields; replace internal ticket descriptions with short codes (e.g., TKT-1234) and include a separate mapping in our internal portal (do not upload internal Jira links).
- If Nova signs an NDA amendment requesting unredacted appendices, route it to Legal for review and include an explicit scope and purpose clause.

Approve the 12/17 delivery for the redacted findings and remediation mapping. For the portal intake today, provide the redacted exec summary + remediation-log extract.

Rishi Malhotra
Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Tan <compliance@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG baseline: pen test report required for artifact list — initial upload complete

Hi Alicia —

Per our exchange, I uploaded the initial artifacts to your portal this morning: executive summary (redacted) and a remediation-log extract. The portal upload ID is NR-9841-PT-INTAKE.

Artifacts uploaded:
- pen-test-executive-summary-redacted.pdf (PDF)
- remediation-log-20261217.csv (CSV)

Follow-up items:
- We will deliver the redacted findings spreadsheet and the PT findings errata workbook by 12/17 as promised; link will be shared into the portal once finalized.
- If Nova requires appendix-level technical details, please open an NDA amendment request and we'll route to Legal.

Portal upload confirmation: https://grc.novahealth.com/upload/records/NR-9841
Internal index for Nova intake: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/PT-Artifact-Index-9841

Thanks, and let me know if you see any upload problems.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Director, GRC Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pen-test-executive-summary-redacted.pdf (PDF 1.2MB), pt-findings-errata.xlsx (XLSX 220KB)
